current_evidence: planning.data.gov.uk entity 20252 ('Local Requirements', West Devon Borough Council, entry date 2026-10-16) points to /planning-validation/local-requirements, not the application-types page; the guide itself shows no adoption or review date and says it was prepared in line with the Plymouth and South West Devon Joint Local Plan.

issues.detail: The Validation list URL is the 'application types' page. That page lists document headings per application type and the plan rules for tree works; it is not the local requirements list. The local requirements guide is /planning-validation/local-requirements, with one sub-page per topic (biodiversity, DEV32 major/minor, flood risk, foul drainage, surface water, affordable housing, trees, contaminated land, planning statement, etc.). The www. URL also returned a client error when fetched; the non-www version loads.

Grokbot read several local requirement pages but captured no requirement from them. (1) Surface Water Drainage Assessment applies to every planning application; the 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' row reuses the foul drainage FDA1 text instead. (2) DEV32 Carbon Reduction Statement applies to all development, with separate major and minor pages, but no trigger is captured; 'Energy / Sustainability Statement' quotes only the s73 document list. (3) AONB (National Landscape) Statement of Need applies within the AONB. (4) Heritage Statement applies where a heritage asset or its setting is affected. (5) Tree survey/arboricultural information and the Planning Statement (topic pages read but nothing captured). (6) Habitats Regulations recreation mitigation for new residential and tourism development within the 12 km Zone of Influence of the Tamar European Marine Site appears only as narrative in tab_items, not as an app-type requirement.
issues.evidence: Surface water page: 'every planning application needs a Drainage Assessment that identifies how the surface water will be managed'; DEV32 page: 'Policy DEV32 requires all development to contribute to the 50% carbon reduction target by 2034'; local-requirements page cites AONB Statement of Need 'only if the application is within the AONB' and heritage statement 'if the application affects a heritage asset or its setting'

issues.detail: Several requirements sit under clearly wrong application types. (1) Contaminated Land Assessment under Advertisement consent. (2) Affordable Housing Statement under Change of use - prior approval: the source requires it for major residential development, rural exception sites and 5+ dwellings in a designated rural area, and 'includes change of use' refers to planning applications for change of use, not prior approvals. (3) Design and Access Statement under Non-material amendment: the excerpt runs on from another special application type ('Design and Access Statement (where applicable)'), and NMAs do not need a DAS.
issues.evidence: 'Affordable Housing Statement Required for: Major residential development Rural exceptions sites 5 or more dwellings in a designated rural area Includes change of use'

issues.detail: All 9 Full planning rows are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', and several take their text from other application types. Block plan, Design and Access Statement and Energy/Sustainability quote the Removal/Variation of Condition (s73) document list ('Please see Special Application Types for more information about removing or varying a condition'). Ecological Survey and Planning Obligations quote Technical Details Consent (Permission in Principle stage 2) text. Outline, Reserved matters and Variation of condition are marked '(none)', although area- and threshold-based local requirements apply to them (surface water drainage, DEV32 carbon reduction, affordable housing, flood risk, PEA).
issues.evidence: Full planning excerpts: 'Stage 2 - Technical Details Consent (TDC) At this stage the details of the proposed development are assessed'; 'A planning obligation may be required at this stage The TDC will be subject to...'

issues.detail: Several triggers are garbled, cut off or wrong. (1) Noise Impact Assessment under Full planning quotes the wind turbine requirement ('in full compliance with ETSU guidance'), so it applies only to wind turbine proposals. (2) The PEA and Affordable Housing excerpts start with page navigation text ('| West Devon Borough Council Local Requirements Guide Navigation Skip Guide Navigation'). (3) The Flood Risk Assessment and Sequential Test excerpts describe FRA content and method, not when an FRA is required. (4) Photographs/Photomontages quotes a note about material samples, not a photo requirement. (5) The Affordable Housing excerpt is cut off mid-sentence ('with the Affordable Housing policy').
issues.evidence: 'A specific noise report in full compliance with ETSU guidance must be submitted with the application, but only after full pre-application consultation with the Environmental Health Team.'

issues.detail: Most tab_items are not local requirements. (1) The tree-works plan rules (boundaries, north arrow, closest public highway) are filed as 'Drawing / document standards'; they apply only to TPO, conservation-area tree and 5-day felling notices. (2) 'This checklist should be submitted at the beginning of every Ecology Report.' is a fragment. (3) 'Email SDPC Useful Links Statutory Guidance (Gov.UK) ... Sensitive Development Questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 275.11KB)' is link text. (4) Biodiversity narrative such as 'The Local Planning Authority must ascertain that the proposal will not have an adverse effect...' and 'Mitigation measures must be devised in consultation with ecological... consultants' is explanatory text, and one item is cut off ('within the 12 k').
issues.evidence: tab_items 'Submission rules' and 'Local forms / checklists' rows

issues.detail: There are duplicated rows. The tree-plan text appears twice (tab_items 1/3 and 2/4). Under Householder, the same FDA1 foul drainage sentence appears as both 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' and 'Foul Sewage / Utilities Statement'.
issues.evidence: 'A Foul Drainage Assessment (FDA1) form will be required for all residential or commercial development where the applicant does not intend to connect to the mains foul sewer system.' (x2)

issues.detail: Coverage is limited. The application-types and local-requirements pages did not render their accordion or topic lists through the fetch tool, so this audit could compare only the topic pages Grokbot itself read. Other local topics on the live guide may also be missing. No adoption or review date appears on any page, so 'Undated' is correct, though planning.data.gov.uk records a start date of 2024-01-01. The list is run jointly with South Hams (same URL structure and wording), which the workbook notes correctly.
issues.evidence: Fetched /application-types and /local-requirements: headings and intro text only, no dates

summary: Grokbot links the West Devon 'application types' page rather than the local requirements guide (/planning-validation/local-requirements, shared with South Hams). It missed surface water drainage, DEV32 carbon reduction, AONB statement of need and heritage statement triggers, and placed items under wrong types such as contaminated land for adverts, affordable housing for prior approvals and DAS for NMAs.
